ask: Set up a voice for our founder Dana. Her posts should sound like her, not like Acme.

steps.why: Check for a voice already named for Dana and see which voice is the default. The list does not show accounts; get-voice-profile does.

Find a post Dana wrote herself for the sample: one on her account with content_origin manual (written by hand, not by Bolta). Manual alone doesn't prove it was her, so check with her. None? Ask her to paste a paragraph.

arguments.name: Dana
arguments.writing_sample: <a post or paragraph Dana wrote, 50 or more characters>

steps.why: A person voice, not a second brand voice: is_default false keeps Acme's voice as the default. The sample also sets the voice's tone, so it must be hers. account_ids only because she named her own LinkedIn: it moves that account off the Acme voice. Left out, every account no voice owns yet goes to Dana's voice. speaker_mode is not saved on create, so it is set next.
speaker_mode founder makes drafts in this voice write as I.
Read back speaker_mode and account_assignments to confirm what was stored.

say: Dana's voice is saved, writing as "I", and her LinkedIn now uses it. Acme's voice stays the default for everything else. Her angle can be set in Bolta under Brand > Edit voice. Want two first-person posts a week from her, ready for her to approve? That's a Bolta routine on her LinkedIn.
never: A writing sample you or Bolta wrote.
Moving an account she didn't name.
